name: Excel Query Book
Content:
The Excel Query Book provides detailed guidance on using queries within Excel to manage and analyze data efficiently.
It covers how to connect, import, and transform data from multiple sources using Excel’s built-in query tools.
Each sheet includes step-by-step query examples, explanations, and real-world use cases for better understanding.

name: TryHackMe WriteUp
Content:
A detailed collection of TryHackMe room writeups covering beginner to advanced cybersecurity challenges.
Each section explains tools, techniques, and commands used during exploitation and post-exploitation.
Perfect for learners practicing penetration testing and CTF problem-solving.

name: Windows Server and Client Tips & Tricks
Content:
A practical guide to optimizing and managing Windows Server and Client environments.
Covers key topics like user management, network setup, PowerShell automation, and performance tuning.
Ideal for IT professionals and system administrators seeking real-world troubleshooting solutions.
